Class Gamepad

java.lang.Object
input.Gamepad
public abstract class Gamepad extends Object
A game controller, read once a frame by poll().

Subclasses only say which buttons are held (read(), Template Method); this class finds what changed since the last poll and tells the listeners (Observer). When no controller can be used, none() stands in for it, so the rest of the game never has to check.
